text.en: Store staff members regularly earn praise for guiding pet owners through feeding options and answering avian care questions with patience. Longtime shoppers appreciate friendly clerks who recommend suitable food and replace defective items promptly. Nonetheless, a few dissatisfied visitors mention rude customer service and slow checkout assistance during their trips.

Customers describe this North Houston feed store as a large facility featuring an extensive selection of poultry, supplies, and accessories. Visitors frequently appreciate the easy on-site parking and clean shopping aisles. Conversely, one visitor expressed deep distress regarding store hygiene and enclosure maintenance near the entrance.

Pricing evaluations differ notably depending on the products purchased at this feed store. Several clients highlight affordable rates for pet supplies and budget-friendly canine preventive treatments like dewormers. On the other hand, multiple reviewers voice frustration over steep price points and added surcharges when paying with debit cards.

q.en: What kinds of poultry and bird supplies are available at Elsy's?

a.en: Reviewers note a large selection of chickens, roosters, and caged birds, along with birdseed, cages, and nutritional supplies.

q.en: Does the store charge extra fees for card payments?

a.en: A customer noted an added fee when checking out with a debit card, so shoppers may want to ask about payment policies before purchasing.

q.en: Is parking accessible at the store?

a.en: Yes, visitors mention that the store features easy and free on-site parking.
